title: From $L$-domination maximal inequalities to infinite-dimensional martingales, towards high-dimensional statistics
summary: A novel approach is proposed to establish a sharp upper bound on the expected supremum of a separable martingale random field, serving as an alternative to classical universal chaining-based methods. The proposed approach begins by deriving a new "$L$-domination maximal inequality" for a finite class of discrete-time martingales. This is achieved by using some variations of log-sum-exp and softmax functions, as well as martingale transforms, avoiding the simple use of the triangle inequality.
